items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Who else was in the Pierron band? At that time they had Peter Bocchage. He was playing trumpet.

ctx.x: Light sticks. Light sticks. Do you remember anything else about your lessons? What he did? Did you have a method book or how he taught you? Oh, I have a method book. Fisher's method. Oh, Fisher. Yeah, Fisher. Is that the Otto Lange or Carl Fisher? Carl Fisher. It wasn't the Lange? No. Carl Fisher. Because I think Fisher published the Lange method too. Yeah, but at that time it was the Carl Fisher. We haven't talked to his son yet. We'll ask him more about his father too. But is there anything else you can…
